rationale: Authoritative USGS/FWS records identify this title as the 1992 U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service Biological Report by R.A. Barnhart, M.J. Boyd and J.E. Pequegnat. The two Lens records have identical title, abstract, keywords and OA repository links but conflicting 1994 Biological Conservation DOI/volume/page metadata, indicating duplicate manifestations of the same underlying report with erroneous journal metadata.
